entries.name: cramns3
entries.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: fully unwrapped game texture atlas for one NSDF military AMMO pod. Image 1 is the EXACT UV layout guide, not a picture of an object. Paint a flat diffuse atlas into these existing island silhouettes without moving, resizing or rearranging any island. Remove all guide wireframe triangle lines and guide labels; preserve island extents. Background outside islands remains uniform dark grey. Neutral unlit albedo, NO perspective, drop shadow, vignette, preview model, text, grid, exterior border or watermark.
ART DIRECTION: intentional 1970s space-military equipment, muted olive-brown coated metal, restrained ivory details, cobalt-blue ammo identification paint, a little graphite structural metal. Mostly clean broad manufactured surfaces; small edge wear and few bolts. NO sheets of cooling fins, louvres, radiators, repeated framed panels, tiny noisy scratches, camouflage or excessive grunge. The texture must read as ONE designed pod with continuous paint belts around its body, not each polygon pasted with a separate detail image.
TOP LONG BLUE-GREY BAND at x=.04-.96,y=.04-.258 is the entire wraparound body. Paint olive armor with ONE continuous horizontal cobalt blue belt at y=.185-.215 across its full width, thin ivory line on each edge of that belt. A graphite structural base rail along y=.23-.258. Keep the shapes' sawtooth outside outline EXACTLY. Add one small geometrically regular symmetrical white five-point military star at EXACT atlas x=.530,y=.125, overall width .042, height .055. This is the only emblem anywhere. A few small fasteners along the upper and lower rails and a few narrow vertical panel joints only at the physical fold lines in the guide. No vent fins. The body band must be visually continuous left to right.
MIDDLE TAN BAND at x=.06-.94,y=.32-.55 is the tapered upper nose, a SINGLE connected wrap. The upper quarter y=.32-.37 is smooth icy cobalt-blue translucent energy-cap material, subtly bright cyan toward the top edge. Lower three quarters y=.38-.55 are olive armor, with a narrow ivory coupling ring at y=.375. Four subtle longitudinal seams maximum, no vent or fin patterns. Do not repeat the emblem or create miniature hatches on each triangle.
LOWER RIGHT FOUR SMALL GREEN TRAPEZOIDS within x=.56-.96,y=.59-.99 are actual shoulder plates. All four olive metal, thin cobalt-blue outer tip paint, few inset screw heads, quiet continuous shallow panel metal. No insignia or big hatch.
LOWER LEFT PURPLE CROSS within x=.04-.44,y=.59-.99 is the underside: graphite/olive base with a single circular central service coupling and sparse bolts. Not a sunburst, vent or logo. TINY center cap at x=.48-.52,y=.59-.63 is pale cyan-blue, matching the energy tip. All guide colors are replaced by the specified materials, but geometry of every UV island is inviolable.

entries.name: crhpns3
entries.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: fully unwrapped game diffuse atlas for one NSDF military REPAIR pod. Image 1 is the EXACT UV layout guide, NOT an object rendering. Paint texture art into the existing island silhouettes, preserving their precise location, scale and shape. Erase guide text, every triangular wireframe line and all diagram colors. Background outside islands stays uniform dark grey. Flat neutral unlit albedo, no perspective, cast shadows, border, preview model, vignette or watermark. No text or numbers.
ART DIRECTION: coherent military maintenance module, warm ivory enameled metal with emerald-green repair identification, graphite lower structural frame and muted olive NSDF center plate. Restrained believable edge wear, sparse physical fasteners, broad clean manufactured surfaces. NO louvres, cooling fins, radiator grids or repeated little framed panels. Do not texture every triangle separately. These charts wrap as ONE object.
LARGE BLUE-GREY CROSS at x=.03-.68,y=.03-.68 is ONE continuous upper shell, viewed from above. Keep its cross silhouette EXACTLY. It must be warm ivory armor with a coherent emerald-green stripe running down the centerline of each of its four arms and connecting toward the center. The outer end of each arm has a green painted tip with two small steel fasteners. Thin charcoal joins should follow only the large trapezoid/cap boundaries, NOT the guide triangulation. Four arms are visually balanced and use the same design language, but do not make a collage of separate square panels. At exact chart center x=.355,y=.355 is the small raised square NSDF center cap: muted olive metal, ONE regular symmetrical WHITE five-point star centered at x=.355,y=.355, diameter .080 of the full atlas. This star is entirely inside the central square guide face. At x=.355,y=.135 on the upper arm put ONE small emerald green crossed wrench/screwdriver maintenance pictogram on an ivory patch. On the other arms, only restrained shallow scored panel joins and a few screw heads. NO additional stars, shields, dog badges, hatches per triangle or red medical crosses.
SMALL TAN CROSS in the upper right x=.72-.97,y=.03-.28 is the underside: charcoal and olive structural plate, one circular central service coupling, a little green edge trim, sparse fasteners. Keep exact silhouette.
LONG THIN GREEN BAND at x=.03-.97,y=.77-.847 is the entire side wall unrolled continuously. Paint a continuous graphite lower bumper, warm ivory upper sidewall, single slim emerald-green horizontal equipment stripe through the middle, and only a handful of fasteners spaced along it. NO symbols, small boxes, big vent grilles, diagonal hazard stripes or interrupted frame motifs. Maintain the exact wavy polygon perimeter. Continuous design across the full width, not repeated texture tiles.
Do not move UV islands, do not draw a 3D pod, do not leave guide lines or labels in the finished atlas. Make readable material hierarchy and coherent arm paint rather than generic noisy surface detail.
